Title: Visa Application Form to Enter Japan (Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan form), copy published by VFS Global for Dubai, June 2025
Kind: visa
Source: https://www.vfsglobal.com/one-pager/japan/uae/dubai/pdf/Japan-Visa-Application-Form-June-2025.pdf
Fetched: 2026-11-24
Notes: Pages 1-2. This copy has "N/A" pre-printed in some blanks; they are left out, so every blank is empty. The photo box, the official-use box and the closing personal-information notice are left out. [Bnn] ids are added for scoring.
---

(Note 2) Please tick "Yes" if you have received any sentence, even if the sentence was suspended.
[B42] If you answered "Yes" to any of the above questions, please provide relevant details: ....
"I hereby declare that the statement given above is true and correct. I understand that immigration status and period of stay to be granted are decided by the Japanese immigration authorities upon my arrival. I understand that possession of a visa does not entitle the bearer to enter Japan upon arrival at port of entry if he or she is found inadmissible."
